summary: Full mobile-first frontend verification of /builder rebuild per bifrost mirror of circuitdev.fun/build. Tested at 390x844 (mobile), 1440x900 (desktop) and 390 home. All critical acceptance criteria from the review request pass with ZERO console errors across every page.

mobile_builder_390x844.chips_row_single_line: Stocks / Bolt & log / <> all visible on one row at y~82, within 44px band
mobile_builder_390x844.note_rail_overflow: Rail column internally scrolls past viewport (bottom=927) BUT page body scrollHeight remains 844 — matches upstream behavior per spec.

demo_program.visible_blocks: EV when button Go pressed -> ST change clicks by 1 -> LG if clicks>=3 then post 'Three clicks! Resetting.' + set clicks to 0 else post 'Click {clicks}'
demo_program.reload_no_reseed: After deletion + reload: blocks=0, sessionStorage cpad:demo-seeded='1' persists

remix_q_param.query: When fees land, spend half of them buying the coin back.
remix_q_param.notes: AI compile responded within 1s with 2 blocks (EV when creator fees arrive -> FN buy 50 SOL of TOKEN). Fast upstream response.

desktop_1440x900.note: Builder-menu-button testid is present in DOM at desktop but desktop layout keeps the left palette visible and sidebar visible; no regression observed.

critical_code_review_comments: Builder.jsx is 712 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold. Consider extracting flyout, drawer, and demo-seed effect into separate hooks/components for maintainability.

data-testid coverage is good on the critical interactive surfaces (builder-menu-button, builder-launch-trigger, launch-button, launch-drawer, blocky-flyout-close, block-delete). Family rail buttons and chips row could benefit from stable testids for future automation (currently located geometrically).
test_credentials: none required (no wallet connect / no auth)
seed_data_creation: Demo program auto-seeds on fresh sessionStorage (verified).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All acceptance criteria from the bifrost mirror rebuild pass. Mobile 390x844 geometry matches upstream (page scrollHeight=844=clientHeight, no body scroll, 15 rail buttons 52x46, launch 102x44, run 44 tall, chips single row, header hidden, menu button present). Demo seed works via sessionStorage cpad:demo-seeded and does not reseed after deletion+reload. Flyout open/close works via testid blocky-flyout-close. Launch drawer ?launch=1 auto-opens with dark theme + wallet gate. ?q= remix compiled within 1s to 2 blocks. Desktop and home unchanged. Zero console errors anywhere.
